text:
anya: quick sync 1: we have to finalize GA acceptance for the hosted offering. tradeoff: include advanced batching/autoscale now vs ship narrower with solid SLAs/docs. opinions?

mike: ship narrow. advanced batching still causes memory pressure on some GPUs. risk > reward for GA. we can add a feature flag post-GA.

carla: docs/console team can do the onboarding + runbook if we scope the APIs we document. need clear SLA blurbs + examples for autoscale config.

ben: finance asks for clear pricing caveats. propose: GA publishes default tiers and labels them "pilot pricing" until contracts finalized. also need automated alerts if unit costs deviate.

anya: proposed GA minimums:
- SLA: 99.9% availability for committed hosted plans (measured monthly)
- Measured targets: publish p50/p95 latency per model class (informational)
- Observability: per-route tracing, token-cost view in Console, alerting hooks
- Support: documented escalation path + 24/7 oncall for critical incidents (rotations in playbook)
- Docs: onboarding, troubleshooting runbook, autoscale config examples
- Pricing: default visible tiers + pilot disclaimer; alert if unit cost >20% baseline for 72h

mike: I'll add monitoring rule and a short alert play: ```
alert: pricing_spike
when: unit_cost > baseline * 1.2 for 72h
actions: notify #finops, page-oncall
```

carla: SLA snippet draft: "Redwood Hosted API aims for 99.9% availability for committed customers. Availability is measured as successful requests to the health endpoint over a 30-day window. Latency targets are published per-model but not guaranteed during GA. See SLA doc for measurement details and exceptions."

ben: that's enough for finance to proceed if we attach the cost-alert rule. also want a default billing floor for Dedicated so we don't undercharge pilots.

anya: decision: ship MVP GA = hosted API + basic autoscale + core observability + docs/runbook. Defer advanced batching, multi-model pipelines, and experimental autoscale heuristics to post-GA. owners: carla (docs), mike (monitoring & SLOs), ben (pricing & billing floor).

carla: will open a docs PR with outline and SLA text by EOD.

mike: will push the monitoring rule and a Playbook section for the cost spike alert.

ben: will draft pilot pricing language and default Dedicated floor and share with legal.

ops-bot: Reminder: Add GA oncall rotation to playbook and tag SRE. Link: https://confluence.example/ga-oncall-playbook

anya: thanks all. follow-up sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to sign off on PRs. :white_check_mark:
